name: knowledge-vault
description: Points every bot to the shared Obsidian team knowledge vault (mirza-vault) and its conventions, so lessons, decisions, concepts, patterns, references, and open questions are captured as reusable, interlinked atomic notes instead of being lost in per-session logs. Behavioral skill that activates when a bot produces or needs durable team knowledge; the vault's _meta/Conventions.md remains the single source of truth.
